name: Vive – AI Content Refresh for SEO
author: LeSEO

sections.description:
Your old posts already have the backlinks, the authority, and the Google trust. Most people forget about them and write something new instead, starting from zero.

Vive reads how you already write, then rewrites your old posts with fresh facts and better depth while keeping your voice, your stories, and your links. You see every change side by side before anything is saved.

Nothing to set up

Install, activate, done. Vive sets up its own free key the first time you open it. No account to create, no API key to copy, no credit card.

How It Works

  1. Learn your voice — One click. Vive reads your recent posts and works out your tone, structure, and habits.
  2. Pick an old post — Vive shows your oldest posts first, because those have had the longest to go stale.
  3. Review the diff — Green is added, red is removed. Nothing is hidden.
  4. You decide — Save as a draft to edit yourself, or publish. Vive never publishes on its own.

Why Refresh Instead Of Writing New

  • Old posts with backlinks already have ranking power. A new post starts with none.
  • Google re-crawls content that genuinely changed.
  • Your existing links amplify the update. No outreach needed.
  • Rewriting is faster than writing from scratch.

Features

  • Voice matching — Analyzes your published posts and writes like you, not like generic AI
  • Refresh old posts — Updates stale facts and thin sections, keeps your anecdotes and structure
  • Write new posts — Generate from scratch using the same voice
  • Diff view — See exactly what changed before you accept it
  • Writing rules — Set hard rules the AI must follow
  • Live research — Checks the web for current facts while writing
  • 19 languages — English, German, Polish, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Turkish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian
  • Usage tracking — See how many refreshes you have left

Free And Premium

Free includes 5 refreshes per 3-week cycle, with everything above. Premium is $20/mo for unlimited refreshes. No paywall on install.

Review Before Publishing

AI output is a draft, not a finished post. Read it, edit it, then publish. Saving as a draft is the default for a reason.

External Services

This plugin connects to the LeSEO.app AI service to generate and refresh post content.

What is sent, and when:

  • Post content and your writing settings — sent when you generate or refresh a post.
  • Your site address — sent once on first use, to create your free key. It is stored so that reinstalling the plugin returns the same key instead of a new free allowance.
  • Your API key — sent with every request, to identify your site and count usage.

Your IP address is recorded briefly when the free key is created, to stop one person creating unlimited free keys. It is deleted within 24 hours.

Service provider: LeSEO.app
Terms of Service: https://leseo.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://leseo.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install through Plugins > Add New, or upload the vive-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu.
  3. Click Vive in the sidebar. Your free key is set up automatically.
  4. Click Read my posts and learn my voice so rewrites sound like you.
  5. Pick an old post and refresh it.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No. Vive sets one up for your site the first time you open it. There is nothing to copy or paste, and no account to create.

Do I need an account?

Not for the free plan. An account is only needed if you upgrade to Premium.

Does it publish automatically?

Never. You review the changes and choose Save as draft or Publish yourself.

What if I uninstall and reinstall?

Your site keeps the same key and the same usage count. Reinstalling does not reset your free refreshes.

Will it sound like AI wrote it?

That is the part Vive is built around. Click Read my posts and learn my voice first and it copies your existing tone and structure. Skip that step and it will sound generic.

What languages are supported?

English, German, Polish, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Turkish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Czech, Romanian, and Hungarian.

Is my content sent to third parties?

Your post content is sent to the Vive service to be processed. It is not stored, not shared, and not used for training. See the privacy policy for details.

Can I customize the writing style?

Yes. Settings has a free-text field for how you write and another for hard rules the AI must always follow. Both can be filled in automatically from your posts.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • No account or API key needed. The plugin sets up its own free key on first use.
  • Reinstalling no longer resets your free refreshes.
  • Rebuilt the dashboard around your oldest posts instead of a menu of buttons.
  • Rewrote Create, Refresh, and Settings in plain language.
  • Learning your writing voice now saves automatically.
  • Post picker lists oldest posts first, was newest first.
  • Save as draft is now the default action, Publish is secondary.
  • Hid menu items for features that are not built yet.
  • Clearer error when the plugin cannot reach its server.

1.0.2

  • Fixed permission callbacks for /publish and /save-draft — derive publish/edit capability from post type object instead of hardcoded strings

1.0.0

  • Initial public release
  • Auto-discover writing persona from existing posts
  • Revive old posts with AI
  • Create new posts from scratch
  • Diff view for comparing changes
  • Multi-language support
  • Usage tracking and limits
